post.text:
This morning, I have one question — where is Trump's Budget Director Russell Vought?

The architect of Project 2025 has gone completely missing in front of the Budget Committee, probably because he can't defend the administration's disastrous, unpopular economic record. https://t.co/CGoAsNf7Ye
post.author_description: Official Legislative Account | Ranking Member @HouseBudgetDems, Co-Chair @BlueCollarDems, Proud Father, Loyal Philly sports fan and Fighter for PA-02

description.description: A photograph showing Representative Brendan Boyle, a ranking member of a committee, holding up a prop milk carton during a hearing. The milk carton features a "MISSING" notice with a photograph of OMB Director Russell Vought. An American flag and other individuals are visible in the background.
